While the slot waits on the board (+0x120 == 1) it takes the result when the board has finished the call on the slot's socket (http_board_done_locked with the slot's socket returns 1, then http_board_result_take) or counts a wait frame (http_wait_tick), and returns until 9600 (0x2580) frames have passed, then forces state 8. States 3 to 5 set the wait flag after every step, also one that just succeeded, and the pass that takes the board result returns without running a step, so those steps run every second frame.
